response.content:
Change: in `index.js`, removed the hyphen from `matchOperatorsRegex`, so `escape('-')` now returns `-` instead of `\-`. A lone `\-` is an invalid identity escape under `new RegExp(..., 'u')`, so literals containing hyphens previously threw in Unicode mode.

```js
const matchOperatorsRegex = /[|\\{}()[\]^$+*?.]/g;
```

Preserved behavior: non-string inputs still throw `TypeError`, and all other escaped operators are untouched, so ordinary literal matching is unchanged.

Verification: `node --test literal.test.cjs` → 3 pass, 0 fail (ordinary literals, Unicode-embedding with hyphens, non-string rejection).
